name: UE4SS Lua Log Bridge
description: Leveled logging for UE4SS Lua mods through a native C++ bridge: per-module and per-category levels you can change in-game, UE4SS.log or per-mod log files, immediate, per-frame or periodic writing on its own thread, and a crash-safe journal.

settings.Label: Global log level
settings.Description: The level every mod logs at unless its own level is set: lines below it are not written. Module levels go in settings.ini under [Levels], as Module=DEBUG or Module.category=TRACE (a name or a number from 1 for Trace to 7 for Off). Takes effect at once.

settings.Label: Enable load-time verifications
settings.Description: Runs the bridge's in-game checks when the game loads and writes PASS and FAIL lines to UE4SS.log. Takes effect on the next launch.
